import importlib.util
import random
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(17)
alphabet = ["s%d" % i for i in range(24)]
best = None
for trial in range(40):
    atoms = []
    for i in range(10):
        op = rng.choice(("endswith", "contains"))
        atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(12, 16))]))
    monitors = [mod._monitor(op, list(p), alphabet) for op, p in atoms]
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        states, trans = mod._build_product(monitors, len(alphabet))
        el = time.time() - t0
        print("product %d states in %.2fs" % (len(states), el))
        if best is None or len(states) > best[0]:
            best = (len(states), atoms, trans, states)
    except mod.ReqError as exc:
        print("E_COMPLEXITY after %.2fs" % (time.time() - t0))
print("best:", best[0] if best else None)

# time the full pipeline on the largest case
if best:
    atoms = best[1]
    req = {"services": alphabet,
           "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": op, "path": p}} for op, p in atoms],
           "queries": []}
    import json
    payload = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
    import subprocess, sys
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    print("full run %.2fs rc=%d bytes=%d" % (time.time() - t0, p.returncode, len(p.stdout)))
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    print("minimized states:", len(out["dfa"]["accept"]))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/perf2.py
